name: M15 synchronized FX relative-strength rank follow and reverse basket batch

research.category: intraday cross-sectional FX relative-strength rank screening

source_references.citation: Menkhoff, Sarno, Schmeling and Schrimpf (2012), Currency Momentum Strategies, Journal of Financial Economics 106(3), 660-684
source_references.supports: The opened paper forms monthly winner-minus-loser portfolios across up to 48 currencies and finds cost-sensitive momentum. It supports cross-sectional ranking as an estimand, not four-change M15 formation, four-leg major-FX execution, or 30-60-minute persistence.

research.evidence_summary: This is a severe horizon and universe adaptation of primary monthly evidence. The intraday four-change rule, six-currency rank, and reversed response are speculative and fully counted.

feasibility.rationale: Uses synchronized completed OHLC from six declared pairs and atomic four-leg signal-close baskets, but V2 has not confirmed cross-symbol ranking, atomic portfolio, or sleeve-level result semantics.

market.base_timeframe: Synchronized M1 aggregated causally to M15
market.session: Weekday rank signals from synchronized completed M15 bars ending 09:00 through 13:45 Europe/London; every selected leg exits no later than 15:00

data.frequency: Interval-start M1 OHLC synchronized across all six pairs and aggregated into Europe/London wall-clock M15 intervals
data.minimum_history: Fixed V2 development data only, with 98 valid observed M15 closes per symbol through t and all six t-4..t windows synchronized and physically contiguous
preprocessing: Treat M1 timestamp ts as [ts,ts+1 minute) and require 15 consecutive unique valid candles per symbol per London M15 bar
Valid OHLC is finite and positive with high>=max(open,close), low<=min(open,close), high>=low; any symbol defect suppresses the synchronized pre-entry rank
Require identical UTC interval ends across all six symbols for t-4..t
Use foreign-currency orientation o=+1 for EURUSD GBPUSD AUDUSD NZDUSD and o=-1 for USDCHF USDCAD so positive o*log return means the non-USD currency appreciated
Compute each symbol's observed-sequence TR and Wilder ATR(96), seeded by first 96 valid TRs and frozen through t-1
Use IANA Europe/London rules and canonical UTC storage
dependencies: Atomic four-leg basket entry and cell accounting
V2 resolved signal-time spread, commission and slippage per selected leg
limitations: Primary evidence is monthly and includes up to 48 currencies, not six majors intraday
Four-change formation and two-by-two sleeves are original
Exact ranks can be unstable when dispersion is small

hypothesis.behavior: The two strongest foreign currencies versus USD over four synchronized M15 changes may continue outperforming the two weakest over the next 30-60 minutes, or the spread may reverse.
hypothesis.mechanism: Cross-sectional ranking may isolate relative currency-specific flow from the common USD component; short-horizon crowding or bid/ask effects could instead reverse the spread.
works_when: Both long and short sleeves survive costs
fails_when: Six-pair ranks are noisy or common-USD dominated
The monthly effect does not transfer intraday
falsifiable_predictions: Both hold cells for one response mode have positive basket net R under normal/doubled costs
The 60-minute center is positive in both UTC halves and both sleeves contribute positively
Both cells survive common five-date removal and sample gates

definitions.name: foreign_orientation
definitions.formula: o_s=+1 for EURUSD GBPUSD AUDUSD NZDUSD; o_s=-1 for USDCHF USDCAD

definitions.name: foreign_strength_score
definitions.timing: Four synchronized completed M15 changes; all six scores required

definitions.name: rank_selection
definitions.formula: sort scores descending; TOP={ranks 1,2}, MIDDLE={3,4}, BOTTOM={5,6}
definitions.timing: Known at synchronized t close; suppress if rank-2 equals rank-3 or rank-4 equals rank-5 exactly

definitions.name: foreign_currency_side
definitions.formula: FOLLOW_RANK: +1 for TOP, -1 for BOTTOM; REVERSE_RANK: -1 for TOP, +1 for BOTTOM; MIDDLE=0

definitions.name: pair_trade_side
definitions.formula: foreign_currency_side*o_s; +1 means long pair and -1 short pair

definitions.name: atr96_prior_by_symbol
definitions.formula: Wilder ATR(96) for each selected symbol through t-1
definitions.timing: Frozen before basket signal; every selected leg requires finite positive ATR

entries.long_condition: for selected symbol s: valid synchronized rank AND pair_trade_side_s=+1 AND cell has no open basket
entries.short_condition: for selected symbol s: valid synchronized rank AND pair_trade_side_s=-1 AND cell has no open basket
entries.signal_time: Synchronized close of London M15 interval ending 09:00 through 13:45 on weekday when signal time plus holding_minutes<=15:00
entries.execution_details: Atomically enter the four selected legs at their final synchronized M1 chart/bid closes; V2 applies each leg's resolved/fallback spread, commission and slippage. No partial basket is permitted. Entry candles cannot trigger stops; management starts next M1.
entries.order_type: Four simultaneous supported signal-close market orders
restrictions: Cell must be flat across its entire basket
All six rank inputs and all four selected ATRs, costs and sizes must be valid/representable or the cell skips the whole event
A cell reevaluates ranks only when flat; rank changes cannot rebalance an open basket

exits.stop_loss: Each selected leg uses one frozen symbol ATR: long bid-chart stop=signal_close_bid-ATR_s; short=signal_close_bid+ATR_s. Long triggers bid, short executable ask; adverse gaps fill at worse executable open with costs.
exits.time_exit: Exit every surviving selected leg at its synchronized M1 close ending exactly signal_time plus holding_minutes; any invalid required selected-leg interval in (entry_time,due_exit_time] fails the entire affected cell; on a valid due bar each leg resolves STOP_LOSS before TIME_EXIT
exits.maximum_holding: At most 60 minutes and never after 15:00 Europe/London
exits.end_of_session: No basket matures after 15:00; a post-entry required-leg defect fails the affected cell rather than retaining a partial estimand

risk.position_sizing: Each cell owns one isolated rank-basket portfolio. Four selected legs size from one common pre-entry equity snapshot at 0.10% chart-stop risk per leg before costs; no state crosses cells.
risk.maximum_risk_per_trade: 0.10% current equity per selected leg before costs
risk.gross_exposure_limit: Exactly four selected legs and at most 0.40% aggregate initial chart-stop risk per basket per cell
risk.leverage: Require every selected leg to satisfy V2 size/leverage limits; otherwise skip the entire cell event
risk.concurrent_positions: Within a cell either zero or one four-leg rank basket; four cells independently track equity, positions and failures

experiment.baseline: four-change six-currency rank/top-two versus bottom-two/four one-ATR legs; FOLLOW_RANK; hold=60
robustness_tests: Report all four cells as event-level rank-basket portfolios and retain full breadth ledger
Report basket events, selected-leg counts, long/short sleeve contributions, every currency's selection frequency/contribution and UTC-midpoint halves
Double spread, commission and slippage individually on every selected leg
For each mode center hold=60 remove five best normal-cost London basket dates from both hold cells; require both normal/doubled basket net R positive
For both cells use eligible synchronized London weekdays including zero-event dates and 10000 circular five-date bootstrap resamples seed 2026020; center basket lower bound must exceed zero
Mode advances only if hold=60 center and hold=30 neighbor both pass
Require center at least 300 basket events and 1200 entered legs; require both top and bottom sleeve net contributions positive in each half
Report boundary-tie suppressions, missing-symbol suppressions, unrepresentable atomic baskets, selection concentration and common-USD net exposure
costs: Use resolved/fallback spread, commission and slippage at every selected-leg fill
Double each component for all selected legs
benchmarks: Zero basket net R after all selected-leg costs
Opposite response mode on identical ranks
experiment.multiple_testing: Count all 340 selectable R007-R020 cells, two R008 diagnostics, the full Menkhoff currency-momentum family, R005 diagnostics, R019 breadth basket, and every named cross-sectional FX rank/momentum trial. Cross-batch promotion uses full ledger; incomplete IDs prohibit confirmation; no best-cell/family/currency rescue.
rejection_criteria: Reject mode unless both holds have positive basket net R normal/doubled
Reject if center basket net R is non-positive in either UTC half or either ranked sleeve contribution is non-positive in either half
Reject if center has fewer than 300 basket events or 1200 legs
Reject if five-date removal makes either cell non-positive
Reject if center bootstrap lower bound is not above zero
Reject promotion on required-cell or atomic-basket data failure
Never access holdout without explicit authorization for separately frozen version

pseudocode: Build synchronized valid London M15 bars for all six pairs.
Maintain per-symbol observed-sequence ATR96 through t-1.
At eligible t compute six four-change foreign-oriented log returns and deterministic ranks.
Suppress selection-boundary ties; choose top two and bottom two.
For each flat cell map follow/reverse foreign sides to pair sides, validate four sizes/costs, then atomically enter selected legs.
From next synchronized M1 process each selected-leg stop before due exit; any required-leg defect fails the cell.
Publish four basket cells, sleeve/currency contributions and full robustness/ledger rows.
required_libraries: existing V2 synchronized candle, timezone, cost, fill and R-accounting components
data_structures: Atomic four-leg basket state per cell
edge_cases: exact score ties at selection boundaries suppress event
ties wholly within a selected or middle sleeve use fixed symbol order only for reporting and do not change membership
all-zero or insufficiently distinct ranks suppress through boundary ties
invalid selected size suppresses whole cell basket
each leg stop precedes due exit
adverse gaps use worse executable opens
post-entry defect in any required selected leg fails whole affected cell
implementation.computational_requirements: One synchronized causal pass over six symbols with four isolated atomic rank-basket portfolios.
known_backtester_gaps: Queue waits for V2 synchronized cross-symbol ranking, atomic four-leg basket, sleeve-level result and per-leg cost/fill compatibility confirmation
